gs.vorfall.zusage_nicht_verkaufen_gehalt: You promised in public not to sell %1, and he is still in the squad. The board sees that your word counts, the fans are happy, and the press remembers the promise and gives you credit. %1 himself feels backed.

The fans feel deceived, the board rebukes the broken word, and the journalists will remind you of it at the next chance. In the dressing room, %1's morale drops, and so does the others' trust in your promises.
gs.vorfall.zusage_saisonziel_gehalten.be: Promise kept: season above the target
gs.vorfall.zusage_saisonziel_gehalten.te: You promised to finish the season above the season target. The team finished better than the target. The board rewards it, the fans celebrate it, and the press writes about it.
gs.vorfall.zusage_saisonziel_gebrochen.b: Promise broken: season target not beaten
gs.vorfall.zusage_saisonziel_gebrochen.t: You promised to finish the season above the season target. The target was not beaten. The board counts that as a broken word, the press holds it against you, and the fans are disappointed.
